neighbours.label: the word 'initiate' and its forms (initiate, initiated, initiating, initiation), not 'initial' or 'initiative'
fire: The board voted to initiate a search for a new director.
The programme was initiated by a group of local teachers.
Each new member goes through an initiation rite in the first month.
The union is initiating talks with the employer this week.
Doctors usually initiate treatment as soon as the diagnosis is confirmed.
The lawsuit was initiated after months of failed negotiation.
The software will initiate a backup at midnight.
The project marked her initiation into the world of film.
quiet: The board voted to begin a search for a new director.
The programme was started by a group of local teachers.
Each new member goes through an initial interview in the first month.
The union is opening talks with the employer this week.
Doctors usually commence treatment as soon as the diagnosis is confirmed.
The lawsuit was the mayor's own initiative after months of failed negotiation.
The software will launch a backup at midnight.
The project marked her entry into the world of film.

notes: Card: ' initiate' x12, ' initiated' x8, ' initiation' x4, ' initiating' x2 of the top 32. Probes: initiate 0.91, initiation 0.73, initiated 0.64; start 0.02, 'initial … initiative' 0.01.
